# HOW TO ~~PLAY~~ PROMPT

This is the #1 rule. Don't be vague. Be a specific commander. Tell the AI exactly which game pieces to put on the board.

**BAD PROMPT:** "Get my new leads from a form and save them."

**VIBE PROMPT:** "Create a workflow that starts with a **Webhook Trigger**. When data is received, send it to an **AI Agent**. This agent needs to classify the lead's industry as 'Tech', 'Finance', or 'Other'. Then, use a **Switch Node** to route the lead based on that classification. 'Tech' leads go to the **Google Sheet** named 'Tech Leads'. 'Finance' leads go to the **AirTable** base 'Finance Leads'."

Don't just list the ingredients; give it the recipe, step-by-step. Use words like "First," "Then," "Next," "After that," and "Finally."

- **BAD PROMPT:** "I need to check stocks and send an email."
- **VIBE PROMPT:** "**First**, start with a **Schedule Trigger** that runs every day at 9 AM. **Second**, use an **HTTP Request** node to **GET** the stock price for 'TSLA' from the Yahoo Finance API. **Third**, use an **If Node** to check if the price is below $180. **Finally**, if it _is_ true, use the **Gmail** node to send an email to me@myemail.com with the subject 'BUY TSLA.'"

This is the power move you mentioned. You can replace a ton of "Edit Fields" or "Split Out" logic with one Code Node. Just tell the AI to write the code _for_ you.

- **BAD PROMPT:** "Filter my emails."
- **VIBE PROMPT:** "I have a list of new users from a **Webhook**. I need to process them with a **Split Out** node. For each user, I need to use a **Code Node**. Inside this **Code Node**, write JavaScript to:
  1. Take the email field.
  2. Check if it's a personal email (gmail.com, outlook.com, etc.).
  3. If it is, add a new field called is_personal and set it to true.
  4. If it's not, set is_personal to false.
     After that, use an If Node to check that is_personal flag."
![Description](https://i.imgur.com/JflVyiv.png)

## Use "The Joker" (The Code Node Cheat Code)
## Know Your AI (Agent vs. LLM)

### 🔲 The "Practice Mode" Button
* **Game Piece:** Manual Trigger
* **Vibe Check:** Your "go" button. You will use this 99% of the time while you're building and testing any workflow.

### 🔲 The "Alarm Clock"
* **Game Piece:** Schedule Trigger
* **Vibe Check:** Use this for any recurring task: "run this every morning at 9 AM," "check this every hour," "send a report every Friday."

### 🔲 The "Magic Portal"
* **Game Piece:** Webhook Trigger
* **Vibe Check:** This is your "instant reaction" piece. It creates a unique URL for other apps to send data to, starting your workflow *immediately*.

### 🔲 The "Trap Card"
* **Game Piece:** App Triggers (e.g., Google Sheets Trigger)
* **Vibe Check:** A pre-built "Magic Portal" for a specific app. Use this when you want to react *instantly* to an event, like "a new row is added."

### 🔲 The "Character Sheet"
* **Game Piece:** Edit Fields (or "Set")
* **Vibe Check:** The most useful piece on the board. Use this to add, change, rename, or combine any data. (e.g., `firstName` + `lastName` = `fullName`).

### 🔲 The "Chat Box"
* **Game Piece:** Chat Trigger
* **Vibe Check:** This is the "Start" square for any conversational AI. The workflow begins when a user sends a message.

### 🔲 The "Party Splitter"
* **Game Piece:** Split Out (or "Split in Batches")
* **Vibe Check:** Use this ANY time you have a *list* (an array) of items and need to process *each one individually*. It breaks the party up.

### 🔲 The "Rally Point"
* **Game Piece:** Aggregate
* **Vibe Check:** The exact opposite of "Split Out." Use this to group all your individual items back into one big list after you're done processing them.

### 🔲 The "Fork in the Road"
* **Game Piece:** If Node
* **Vibe Check:** Your simple "yes/no" decision maker. Routes your data down a "True" path or a "False" path.

### 🔲 The "Sorting Hat"
* **Game Piece:** Switch Node
* **Vibe Check:** A more powerful "If." Use this when you have *more than two* possible outcomes (e.g., Path 1 for "Urgent", Path 2 for "Invoice", Path 3 for "Spam").

### 🔲 The "Grand Central Station"
* **Game Piece:** Merge Node
* **Vibe Check:** Essential for re-joining your workflow. After your data goes down different "If" or "Switch" paths, this node brings them all back together.

### 🔲 The "Pause" Button
* **Game Piece:** Wait Node
* **Vibe Check:** Use this to intentionally pause the workflow. Perfect for staggering actions or waiting for an external API to cool down.

### 🔲 The "Spy"
* **Game Piece:** HTTP Request
* **Vibe Check:** Your ultimate secret weapon. If n8n doesn't have a node for a service, this piece lets you "spy" on its API to GET or POST data.
![Description](https://i.imgur.com/Ah8UlkP.png)

### 🔲 The "Treasure Chest"
* **Game Piece:** Storage Nodes (e.g., Google Sheets, AirTable, Notion, Postgres, Data Table)
* **Vibe Check:** The most common "Finish" square. This is the "Bank" or "Vault" where you save your processed data.

### 🔲 The "Message Received" Signal

* **Game Piece:** Respond to Webhook
* **Vibe Check:** Only used with the "Magic Portal" (Webhook Trigger). This sends a "Got it, thanks!" message back to the other app.

### 🔲 The "Joker" (Wildcard)
* **Game Piece:** Code Node
* **Vibe Check:** The "cheat code" piece. Use this to replace 5-10 other nodes with a single, fast code block. You don't need to know code, just ask the AI to write it for you!

### 🔲 The "Scribe" / "Lore Master"
* **Game Piece:** Basic LLM Nodes (e.g., "Message a model," "Basic LLM Chain," "AI Transform")
* **Vibe Check:** Use this when you want the AI to **THINK & RESPOND.** It's for simple "judgment" tasks: summarize text, classify sentiment, extract data, or re-write text.

### 🔲 The "Dungeon Master" (DM)
* **Game Piece:** AI Agent
* **Vibe Check:** The most powerful piece. Use this when you want the AI to **DECIDE & ACT**. You give it "Tools" (other nodes) and "Memory," and it decides *which* tools to use to win the game for you.

### 🔲 The "Data Alchemist"
* **Game Piece:** AI Transform
* **Vibe Check:** A simple, fast AI "Scribe." Use this for single-shot tasks like extracting structured data (JSON) from messy text, summarizing a block of text, or translating language.
